by-GrKy.title: Houses: tidy classical, pastel walls
by-GrKy.summary: The trekker shows a historic centre with well-kept classical European buildings, many white or pastel, on mostly pedestrian-only roads.

by-JIQL.title: Road: grey rectangular tiles
by-JIQL.summary: The trekker walks mostly on grey rectangular tiles, with a small part of pinkish tiles in a pattern.

by-Jq87.title: Coverage: one walking trekker
by-Jq87.summary: Apart from border spills, the only coverage is one walking trekker in a capital's old centre. The camera is lower than a normal car and mostly on pedestrian streets.

by-USRk.title: Sign: sea-green street signs
by-USRk.summary: Street signs in the centre are sea-green and seen almost everywhere. Up close they read вул, the Belarusian word for street.

by-aHmA.title: Landmark: cathedral with two towers
by-aHmA.summary: A cathedral with two towers features prominently and is often visible from far away.

by-nIJX.title: Language: Cyrillic, two letters unique
by-nIJX.summary: Signs are in Belarusian or Russian, both in Cyrillic. The letters ў and і do not exist in Russian.

differs.how: Russian has no ў or і
